en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed the runner and orchestrator freezing (no polls, `/healthz` or `SIGTERM` shutdown) while nobody reads their output; logs keep the latest 256 KiB and count drops (not on Windows)
zh: 自托管运行器：修复在无人读取输出时运行器和编排器冻结（不再轮询、`/healthz` 无响应或 `SIGTERM` 无法关闭）的问题；日志保留最新 256 KiB 并统计丢弃量（Windows 上除外）
